title: NHSRC Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Consultant Posts
description: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Consultant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech, or MCA can use this opportunity and apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the application ends. Here we have included more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the NHSRC Notifi...
